Package com.example.releasethekraken.model

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.releasethekraken.model.Event
public class Event extends Object
Represents an event within the system. This class stores essential event information including identification, title, description, registration timeframes, capacity, poster metadata, and access control settings.

      public Event(String eventId, String title, String description, long registrationStartMillis, long registrationEndMillis, int capacity, String posterUrl, boolean isPrivate, List<String> invitedUserIds, List<String> coOrganizerIds, String organizerId, boolean geolocationRequired)

      geolocationRequired - True if entrants must share location data.
